title: SSE transport timeout — root cause
symptom: First tools/call probe timed out at 120s during cold concurrent transport sweep
root_cause: Transient sandbox agent SSE reader cold-start failure: zeroshield-mcp-sandbox logs show httpx.ReadTimeout in _sse_reader_loop → UpstreamError(-32003, 'upstream SSE connect timeout'). The legacy HTTP+SSE transport requires a persistent GET /sse reader before POST /messages; on reader reconnect/timeout the first RPC can stall until method_timeout.
recovery: Subsequent probes succeed: tools/list 156ms (13 tools), tools/call 44ms Echo: sse-probe with numeric jsonrpc id
recommendation: Treat first-call SSE timeout as cold-start/backpressure; broker already returns retryable 503 on provisioning; consider eager warm on server sync for sse transport
